ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on the distal lobe regions to low-intensity black pixels across the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black region extending from the peduncle to the median notch; distal lobes feature high-intensity white fields with localized black mottling and speckling; a distinct high-contrast white circular ring is visible on the interior left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped median notch with a narrow vertex angle estimated at 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys; most pronounced jaggedness occurs at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the anterior-facing edge; trailing edge lobes exhibit a transition from slight concavity near the notch to convexity toward the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of small, dark, circular punctate markings on the white distal lobe surfaces; a specific white circular rosette-like ring is present on the dark inner-left quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear mark cutting through the white pigmentation on the right lobe; several finer, unaligned scratch marks visible on the far right distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable reddish-pink fleshy protrusion or lesion visible at the ventral junction of the peduncle and fluke on the left side; irregular edge degradation on the far right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, well-defined white ring-shaped mark located on the dark pigmentation of the left lobe.
